title: Copilot Studio: Python Code node as a step in workflows
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly says new workflow runs stop when prepaid environment capacity is exhausted, even though enabled overage sources can supply more credits. The allocation API is documented and valid; the billing wording and two checklist monitoring steps also need minor corrections.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing: Meter; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft Copilot harness experiences are metered in Copilot Credits, supporting the variable cost rating.
claims.quote: Usage-based billing: Usage is billed based on consumption and measured in Copilot Credits. Creating and using agents, workflows, and apps consumes credits based on usage and rate of consumption.

claims.claim: The usage-based billing page says the Microsoft Copilot harness charges credits from the moment building starts.
claims.quote: Unlike the standard harness, which starts billing after publish, the Microsoft Copilot harness charges credits from the moment you start building.
claims.fix: Replace the final Meter sentence with: 'Workflows can consume credits before publication: natural-language creation, testing and evaluation are billed, but manual canvas authoring, adding actions and configuring parameters are not.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-copilot-studio/guidance/workflows-credit-consumption, whose workflow-specific guidance qualifies the cited overview.

claims.claim: PUT https://api.powerplatform.com/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=2024-10-01 writes environment credit allocations and tenant-pool enforcement.
claims.quote:
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Put `
    -Uri "$apiBaseUrl/licensing/allocationsV2?api-version=$apiVersion" `
    -Headers $headers -ContentType "application/json" -Body $allocationBody

claims.claim: The allocation request body sets enforcementRules with ruleType TenantPool.
A published environment-group rule governing tenant-pool draw rejects individual environment updates with TenantPoolLockedByPolicy in both the admin center and API.
claims.quote: If a published environment group rule governs Draw from the available capacity in my tenant, you can't override the setting for an individual environment. Updates through the Power Platform admin center, Power Platform API, or administration SDKs are rejected with the TenantPoolLockedByPolicy error.

claims.claim: With no overage source enabled, the environment can consume only allocated prepaid credits.
claims.quote: If no overage source is enabled, the environment can consume only its allocated prepaid credits. Experiences that require credits can stop working after that allocation is exhausted.
